{{Top}}
[[File:2x20_kneesaa_dress.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] seeing her own image on a mirror.]]
{{Quote|If you can't recognize the man in the mirror, it is time to step back and see when you stopped being yourself.|[[Hal Horn]]|<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>}}
A '''mirror''' was a device which showed a reflective image.

The [[Buick]] utilized mirrors on its port and starboard.

A [[hall of mirrors]] was located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

On the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], a group of [[Strutter]]s and the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] had mirrors for seeing themselves.

Mirrors were located at the sides of some vehicles, such as the [[T-4 (vehicle)|T-4]], for rear view.<ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>
